stories.title: spell update migration: preserve customized shims, restore on demand, fix the second-update loss
stories.description: In src/commands/update.ts: shim path + recorded-hash mismatch => keep the file untouched, warn with the remedy, carry the recorded hash forward, dry-run parity; 'Already up to date' only when every tracked file is present, otherwise restore missing files at the same version; after a successful merge record the vendor content's hash, not the merged file's (architecture D5, empirical variants A-D).
acceptanceCriteria: AC8 fixture test: one hand-edited .github/prompts/<id>.prompt.md is byte-identical after update, a warning names it, the untouched sibling is replaced by the shim, .arcane/spells/<id>.md is written, and the manifest still records the pre-edit hash for the edited file
Dry-run prints the same decision without writing
Two consecutive updates through the merge path keep an operator edit (Variant D regression)
A deleted tracked file is restored by a same-version spell update; with nothing missing the command still prints 'Already up to date.'
All existing update tests pass unchanged except the two whose assertions encoded the old behavior
stories.testEvidence: Commit 0c5a47b. test/update.test.ts: AC8 edited/untouched/dry-run fixtures on the real `spells-docs` component (edited file byte-identical, `Kept customized (not merged)` + summary with remedy, fetchPublishedFile never called, pre-edit hash carried forward, siblings replaced, canonical written); variant-D regression (recorded hash == vendor hash after merge; edit survives update 2); could-not-fetch keeps the recorded hash; same-version restore of a deleted tracked file; initOnly still 'Already up to date.'. Two existing 'Already up to date.' tests now seed the tracked file. update/lifecycle/hub-retrofit suites green.
